size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)
cad_stl_scope: in-envelope bay module of the build, metres (X-PAR-04 gate: the cad/stl box equals the node size_mm 2000 x 1000 x 400; the full bed lives in export/ and the STEP - the CRYO_ASU treatment)

machine.type: crop grow bed per the node area_basis (A-M-229): HDPE basin (walls and floor 15 mm) with EPDM liner (5 mm), interior 7280 x 4000 mm = 29.12 m2 (NOT shrunk to fit the study box - A-FARM), LECA media envelope at a 250 mm study depth, drain sump at the bay corner with the N9 drain above it, internal cross-ribs framing the nominal 2000 x 1000 bays, and the LED canopy with the panel envelope (2.0463 kW = 29.12 m2 x 70.3 W/m2, DLI 17 at 2.8 umol/J, A-M-133/A-M-144)

area.basis: crew duty (A-M-229): S14 4.2 kg/d / 0.1442 kg/m2/d; supersedes the A-M-151 residue-line claim studies
area.a_farm: bed area matches the node; liner and drain drawn; not shrunk to fit the block

misfit.note: the full bed leaves the study box by design - the misfit is section-7-reported, nothing resized (plan rule 3; A-FARM area rule governs)

machine.media: LECA media envelope at a 250 mm study depth (the duty names no media depth - hold, WORK_ORDER W12); GROWBED_A media idiom
machine.circulation: duty section 2: 19100.9 kg/d, two-minute holdup 0.0265 m3 - reported, not a residence time claim
machine.purchased: the LED panel envelope (2.0463 kW node stamp, A-M-144) - purchased per plan rule 6
machine.material: HDPE basin, EPDM liner, LECA media (duty section 3: HDPE or PVC for the water; the frame is not the wetted part); canopy painted A500
